ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$, and point $D$ is on $AB$, with $AD=\frac{1}{3}AB$. If $AD=6$, find the length of line segment $CD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because AD= \frac{1}{3} AB$ and $AD=6$,\\
$\therefore AB=18$,\\
$\because C$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
$\therefore AC= \frac{1}{2} AB=9$,\\
$\therefore CD=AC-AD=9-6=\boxed{3}$.
